brief:
Israeli military forces have converted residential homes in Hebron into military posts while the city remains under lockdown, according to Al Jazeera English. The takeovers are part of broader operations involving evictions and raids across the occupied West Bank as tensions escalate in the region.

The actions represent an expansion of Israeli outpost activity in the territory, with forces using civilian structures for military purposes during restrictions on Palestinian movement and access.
dek: Evictions, raids and outpost expansion continue across the occupied West Bank amid heightened tensions.
title: Israeli forces convert Hebron homes into military posts during lockdown
